comment: M5-003 sample rows. normal is the legacy default target: every control accepted, max_launches_per_air_cycle 2 with launch_z_scales 1.0/0.7 (the third launch is refused), knockdown_s 0.45 plus recovering_s 0.25, no poise pool, no immunity. heavy is launch-immune via the explicit allow_launch gate (bypass_poise never bypasses it) with a high poise pool. boss refuses all control through immune_control plus its gates and is death_resistant, but is NOT damage immune - the axes stay separate. max_air_time_s is a bounded positive bound (seconds) so no sample can hang a target in the air forever.
